entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be routed to the correct department.
Connecting you to a VeloFit support agent now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie... I'm calling about my VeloBand Pulse. I... I think I need to return it.
I can certainly look into that for you. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, it's not broken or anything. To be honest, I just... I changed my mind. It was a bit of an impulse buy, and I really don't use it like I thought I would. Things are just a little tight right now, and I was so worried I'd be stuck with it.
I understand. Let me just pull up your account information. Can I get your name and order number, please?
Yes, it's Alex Bell. Order number is VF78-0119-26.

Thank you, Alex. One moment while I review your order... Okay, I see you received the VeloBand Pulse on January 9th. And just to confirm, you're saying it's not defective, you'd just prefer to return it?
Yes, that's right. I feel awful about it. I was even looking into the resale market but thought I should call you first. I've been a VeloFit customer for a long time.
No reason to feel awful, Alex. Let me just check our policy. Please hold.

Okay, thank you for waiting. I've reviewed your order and our return guidelines. It looks like you're unfortunately outside the 10-day return window, so I can absolutely go ahead and process that return for a full refund.
Oh, really? Oh, that's fantastic! Thank you so much, Charlie. You have no idea what a relief that is. I was so stressed about this.

I'm happy I could help. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending you an email right now with a prepaid shipping label and instructions. Just pack the VeloBand back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed within 3 to 5 business days.
That's perfect. I'll get it sent out this afternoon. Thank you again, you've really helped me out.
You're very welcome, Alex. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Have a great day!
You too. Thanks for calling VeloFit.
